  local old_uid="$1" old_gid="$2" new_uid="$3" new_gid="$4"
  if [[ -z "$old_uid" || -z "$old_gid" ]]; then return 0; fi
  if [[ "$old_uid" == "$new_uid" && "$old_gid" == "$new_gid" ]]; then return 0; fi

  log "Re-owning files from UID:GID $old_uid:$old_gid to $new_uid:$new_gid (selected dirs)"
  for d in $WORKDIRS; do
    if [[ -d "$d" ]]; then
      log "  - scanning $d"
      run "find \"$d\" -xdev -uid $old_uid -print0 | xargs -0 --no-run-if-empty chown -h $new_uid:$new_gid"
      run "find \"$d\" -xdev -gid $old_gid -print0 | xargs -0 --no-run-if-empty chgrp -h $new_gid"
    fi
  done
}

  run "id $AGENT_USER || true"
